The Master of Advanced Studies in Medical Physics Fellowship 2025 is an initiative by the International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP) and the University of Trieste, Italy. This opportunity caters the students who have completed M.Sc. degree in Physics or related fields, particularly from low and medium-income countries. The selected applicants will receive a full or partial scholarship.
To be eligible, an applicant must:
hold a degree equivalent to an M.Sc. in physics or related fields
belong to a low- or middle-income country (preferred but not required)
have an adequate proficiency in the English language
The applicants must be from countries that are members of the United Nations, UNESCO or IAEA.
The qualified candidates will receive the benefit of full or partial scholarships to help cover the cost of the Master's program.
Full support for the registration fee
A monthly stipend (reduced amount if accommodation provided)
Half support for the registration fee
Alternatively, candidates can choose to receive full support for travel and registration fee only
Letter of recommendation from senior scientists familiar with the applicant

The candidates will also be working on a dissertation that will be submitted during the last month of the program.

A maximum of 30 students will be admitted.
Question: What is the Master of Advanced Studies in Medical Physics (MMP) program?
It's a two-year postgraduate program offered by the Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP) and the University of Trieste, Italy.
Question: Who is eligible to apply for the MMP program?
Applicants must hold an M.Sc. degree in physics or a related field. Preference is given to candidates from low and medium-income countries.
Question: Where is the program located?
The first year of coursework takes place at the ICTP in Trieste, Italy, and the second year involves clinical training in a hospital setting.
Question: What is the language of instruction?
The program will be conducted in English.
Question: When does the 2025-2027 program start and end?
The programme will be held from 1 January 2026 until 31 December 2027.
